title: Chana Masala
subtitle: chickpeas in Indian spices
description: Soaked and boiled chickpeas simmered with fried onion, ginger, garlic, tomato and garam masala in a thick sauce. Serve with chapati.

steps.text: Soak the chickpeas in about 6 cups of water with 1 tablespoon bicarbonate of soda for 12 hours, then drain and rinse well.

Place the chickpeas in a large pot with the remaining tablespoon of bicarbonate of soda and plenty of water. Cook for 1 1/2 to 2 hours until tender but still holding their shape. Drain and keep the cooking water.

Finely grate the garlic and ginger and mix. Heat the oil in a medium pot over medium-high heat and fry the chopped onion for 5 to 8 minutes until browned. Add the garlic and ginger and fry for about 2 minutes.
Stir in the ground coriander, then add the diced tomato and cook for about 5 minutes until it starts to break down.
Add the chilli powder (if using), garam masala and salt and cook for another minute. Add the cooked chickpeas and mix well, scraping the base of the pot.

Add 1 cup of the chickpea cooking water and the juice of 1/2 lemon, bring to the boil and cook for about 15 minutes, adding more liquid if needed (the sauce should be thick but not soupy). Taste and adjust, then serve with chapati.
